name: Mortal
description: An ordinary mortal — flesh, breath, and a flicker of qi unawakened.

name: Qi Condensation
description: Qi gathers into the dantian, forming the first cloud of power.

name: Foundation Establishment
description: The dantian becomes a hardened lake. Meridians widen.

name: Core Formation
description: A golden core coalesces, and the body becomes a vessel for legend.

name: Nascent Soul
description: From the core, a small immortal infant blooms — your true self.

name: Soul Transformation
description: The nascent soul matures, body and spirit reshaping each other.

name: Void Refinement
description: You step half-into the void between worlds, drinking starlight.

name: Ascendant Immortal
description: Heaven's gate opens. You are no longer wholly of this world.
